summary:
Beyond Earth’s Bounds

An interactive 3D educational and exploration project designed to bring to life the stories of spacecraft and equipment left behind on the surfaces of the Moon and Mars, such as the Apollo Lunar Modules and the Ingenuity helicopter.

The project offers an immersive experience for audiences of all ages, combining realistic 3D models with interactive storytelling, where each piece of equipment narrates its own story in its unique voice, highlighting its history, achievements, and fate after its mission ends.

It also provides an engaging learning experience through interactive games and activities that reinforce knowledge and understanding. Accessibility is an essential part of the project, featuring sign language support, keyboard navigation, and comprehensive audio-guided tours to help visitors with visual and hearing impairments explore the experience.

The journey concludes with inspiring messages from the equipment to the audience and an achievement certificate awarded upon completing the interactive activities.

Because a mission ending does not mean a story ending. Every footprint in space has a story worth remembering.

Project Details – Beyond Earth’s Bounds

1. What does the project do, and how does it work?

Beyond Earth’s Bounds is an interactive educational and exploration platform designed to help children and people interested in space learn about NASA’s space equipment, spacecraft, and their missions.

The platform combines 3D models, interactive storytelling, educational information, and simulation games to make learning about space more engaging and enjoyable.

Visitors can explore different pieces of space equipment, listen to their stories narrated from their own perspectives, or read the information themselves. Through this experience, users discover the importance of these machines, their scientific achievements, and what happens to them after their missions end.

2. What are the benefits of the project?

The project aims to make NASA’s scientific information and space exploration discoveries more accessible and interesting to a wider audience, especially children.

Its main benefits include:

• Increasing awareness and appreciation of space exploration.

• Encouraging children’s curiosity and love for space and science.

• Introducing visitors to NASA’s equipment, its purposes, and its missions.

• Helping people understand that space exploration is not limited to rockets and astronauts, but also involves many scientific instruments, robotic vehicles, helicopters, and other technologies.

• Raising awareness about what happens to space equipment after missions are completed.

• Presenting scientific information in a simple, interactive, and enjoyable way.

3. What is the expected impact of the project?

We hope this project will increase public awareness of space exploration, inspire a greater interest in space among younger generations, and introduce people to the important role of NASA’s equipment in scientific discoveries.

We also hope to change the way people view abandoned space equipment, helping them recognize that these objects are not simply forgotten machines, but valuable witnesses to humanity’s scientific achievements.

Our goal is to inspire visitors to look beyond the familiar image of rockets and astronauts and discover the many stories and technologies that make space exploration possible.

4. What tools, devices, and software did you use?

We used several tools to develop the project:

• Spline: Used to create and prepare the 3D models and visual elements.

• Google Antigravity: Used as our main development environment to build the website and organize its files.

• ChatGPT and Claude: Used as AI assistants to help us formulate programming instructions, solve development problems, and guide Antigravity throughout the website-building process.

• Netlify: Used to deploy and publish the website online, making it accessible through a public link.

5. What makes your project creative and innovative?

The creative aspect of Beyond Earth’s Bounds lies in transforming abandoned space equipment into storytellers.

Instead of presenting scientific facts through traditional articles, each piece of equipment becomes a character with its own story, voice, and identity.

Our creative features include:

• Interactive and visually engaging 3D models.

• Storytelling narrated from the perspective of each piece of equipment.

• Educational games and simulations that allow visitors to interact with what they have learned.

• An achievement certificate awarded upon completing the activities.

• An experience that combines scientific knowledge, creativity, exploration, and entertainment.

We aim to turn forgotten equipment into memorable characters and transform scientific learning into an adventure.

6. What factors did your team consider during development?

Our team considered different learning preferences and accessibility needs while designing the platform.

We wanted to support visitors who prefer reading stories independently as well as those who prefer listening to narrated stories. We also explored ways to make the experience more accessible to people with disabilities.

Within our current technical resources and capabilities, we attempted to incorporate accessibility features, including dedicated areas intended to support sign language integration.

We recognize that accessibility is an ongoing process and that our current implementation has limitations. If further development opportunities and resources become available, we hope to:

• Improve accessibility features for people with different disabilities.

• Expand sign language support.

• Add more space equipment and 3D models.

• Introduce additional educational activities and exploration features.

• Make the platform more immersive, accessible, and interactive for everyone.

Our main consideration was to create an educational experience that is enjoyable, informative, and welcoming to as many people as possible, regardless of their age or preferred way of learning.

Our Vision

We believe that space exploration is made possible by more than the astronauts who travel beyond Earth. Behind every mission, there are machines, instruments, and technologies that contribute to discoveries and leave their marks on history.

Beyond Earth’s Bounds gives these forgotten explorers a voice, because every mission has a story, and every story deserves to be remembered.
